heading: Pallet Stackers
benefits: Flexible, compact pedestrian pallet stacker for light to medium-duty applications in warehouses and production areas
Versatile use in despatch areas, in support of production or when stocking shelves in ATEX Zones 2/22
Maximum load capacity of 1.6 tonnes with lift heights up to 5.4 metres
Five different mast types and numerous options available
Initial lift for increased ground clearance on uneven floors or ramps

items.text: Continuous monitoring of the safety values and wear relevant to ATEX
Active foot bumper – foot protection system
Long tiller and low chassis skirt
Warning buzzer – for operation in low noise areas
Horn – for operation in noisy environments
Linde BlueSpot – visual warning of truck presence integrated into chassis contours
Linde EX monitoring app for quick, efficient diagnosis of ATEX-relevant safety values
Maintenance-free AC traction motor for EX area
Central 24/7 spare parts, also available for standard and ATEX spare parts
Condition monitoring of the safety values relevant for ATEX via the EX monitoring app from Linde
Linde connect:dt crash detection – allows electronic impact damage monitoring
Proportional speed control – speed dependent on tiller angle
Creep speed – for operation with tiller in vertical position
Ergonomic tiller head with easy access to all controls
Drive wheel: standard polyurethane with grounding bands
Drive wheel: solid rubber with grounding bands
Drive wheel: solid rubber, electrically conductive
Battery connection installed for batteries supplied by Linde
ATEX charging plug, either standalone or built-in

bullets: Certification and documentation according to ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU and other applicable EU standards ensure legal compliance
Thanks to the passive protection concept, forklifts designed for Zone 2/22 can work in explosive atmospheres, it is not necessary to switch them off
Protection of electrical and electronic components and protection against mechanically generated sparks, excessively high temperatures and dangerous electrostatic discharges
Ergonomic tiller head with easily accessible controls
Easy to operate with one hand, even when wearing gloves
Long, low-set tiller arm reduces steering effort
Generous storage for rolls of shrink-wrap, clipboard or scanner
Optional colour display provides information on important truck data
Compact chassis and narrow turning radius for optimum manoeuvrability
Speed up to 6 km/h for fast, effective work
Powerful climbing ability even with a full pallet or double deck load
The long tiller keeps a safe distance between the lift truck and operator
Asymmetrical tiller head for a better loading view when stacking or transporting loads
Operator is protected through deep-drawn chassis and active foot bumper (optional)
Robust three-phase motor with temperature monitor for long operating times
CAN bus structure for easy access to truck data
Optional data transmission for remote diagnostics and software updates
EX monitoring app from Linde enables quick and efficient diagnosis of values relevant to ATEX as well as preventive maintenance for high level of availability
Central supply of standard and ATEX spare parts around the clock
Close-knit service network with certified technicians
